unit_id: 3.1 High Recall Anomaly Detection with Low False Alarms

gap.quote: most prior work treats OOD detection and failure prediction as separated problems, overlooking their closed connection.
most selective classification methods rely on a single scoring function with one decision threshold to accept or reject predictions.

approach.quote: we propose a unified evaluation framework that integrates OOD detection and failure prediction, quantified by our new metrics DS-F1 and DS-AURC, where DS denotes double scoring functions.
we extend the reliable classifier SURE and introduce SURE+

evaluation.quote: Experiments on the OpenOOD benchmark show that double scoring functions yield classifiers that are substantially more reliable than traditional single scoring approaches.

prior_work.answer: OOD 탐지와 오분류 예측을 따로 연구하거나, 점수 하나와 임계값 하나로 판단

remaining.answer: 두 문제를 함께 평가하는 지표와 그에 맞는 분류기

change.answer: 점수 함수를 둘 쓰는 통합 평가 체계와 새 지표 도입

technique.answer: 이중 점수 지표와 SURE를 개선한 SURE+

measures.answer: OpenOOD 벤치마크에서 이중 점수 지표로 측정한 신뢰성

l1.gap: OOD 탐지와 오분류 예측이 분리되어 평가되고 선택적 분류도 점수 하나에 의존해, 둘을 함께 평가할 수 없음
l1.approach: OOD 점수와 ID 신뢰도 점수를 함께 쓰는 통합 평가 체계와 DS-F1, DS-AURC 지표를 만들고, SURE를 개선한 SURE+를 제안
l1.evaluation: OpenOOD 벤치마크에서 단일 점수 방식과 이중 점수 방식의 신뢰성을 비교

l2.gap: Out-of-distribution detection and misclassification prediction are evaluated separately.
l2.approach: Evaluate both tasks jointly with two scoring functions and two thresholds.
l2.evaluation: Compare joint scoring with single-score approaches on a standard benchmark.
l2.query_text: A reliable classifier must both reject unfamiliar inputs and flag its own likely mistakes, yet these tasks are studied and scored separately. How can both be evaluated jointly using separate scores and thresholds, and does this change which methods look best?
